scenarios.title: New submission: upload, encrypt, scan, bank confirmation, verification, notices both ways

status pending until the bank confirms

download decrypts and the SHA-256 matches
verification refused before any bank confirmation
issuing bank (SIMULATED) confirms every field
officer verifies

scenarios.title: Discrepancy: bank says a different amount; verification blocked; flagged; observation answered and closed

checks.name: institution declares Rs 25 lakh (bank book says Rs 20 lakh)
comparison shows the amount MISMATCH
verification refused on mismatch
officer flags the discrepancy
institution receives 'clarification needed' (action rung)
scrutiny observation recorded (mismatch)
institution replies: observation answered
officer closes the observation
missing-documents report lists it as unverified

scenarios.title: Authorised release: scrutiny, DSC approval, NOC, completion only on bank lien discharge

checks.name: institution raises the release request
AICTE notified (release_requested)
section officer completes scrutiny
approval without a valid DSC signature is refused
release gate allows (all mandatory checks pass)
deputy director approves with DSC: NOC issued
NOC alone is not completion (FDR still verified)
institution told: not complete until lien discharge
bank (SIMULATED) confirms lien discharge
only now: released
